title: DeliveryProof Free R3 — 90 synthetic exports technical smoke test

scenarios.reference_capture: 90 unique synthetic MP4 files derived from four genuine bundled demo clips (English and Korean, landscape and portrait)
scenarios.valid_delivery: 90 matching video paths, SHA-256 matched, complete PASS delivery ZIP created and CRC checked
scenarios.invalid_delivery: One changed video, one missing video, one unapproved extra video; FAIL and ZIP blocked

limitations: This is small synthetic media (15 KB per MP4), not an independent 90-real-export large-file performance/quality benchmark.
R3 source engine and R3 original bundled MediaInfo CLI were executed; frozen EXE UI was not driven.
No actual client work, paid Gumroad delivery, customer approval or revenue is established.

The synthetic samples are tiny and their four video templates are reused with distinct legal ISO BMFF free boxes; these are not 90 independently edited real production exports. These elapsed values should not be generalized to real media jobs.
No real production files, external client approval or sales were used.
